documents.body: A subscription can be canceled from Account settings. Access continues until the paid period ends.
documents.title: Subscription cancel

documents.body: Invoice PDFs are available under Account billing. An owner can update the recipient address.
documents.title: Invoice history

documents.body: Use the password reset link on the login screen. Reset links expire after 30 minutes.
documents.title: Password reset

documents.body: Request a refund within 14 days through support. Eligibility is reviewed against the purchase terms.
documents.title: Refund request

documents.body: A member can export their own records as CSV. Workspace exports require owner access.
documents.title: Data export

documents.body: Account deletion requires confirmation from the owner. The demo policy defines a 30-day removal window.
documents.title: Account deletion

documents.body: Atlas demo data stays in the EU region selected at workspace creation.
documents.title: Data region

documents.body: A workspace owner can create a replacement API key and revoke the old key after testing.
documents.title: API key rotation

documents.body: The demo API limit is 120 requests per minute. HTTP 429 includes a retry-after header.
documents.title: API rate limit

documents.body: A webhook retries after delivery failure, with an exponential backoff and a maximum of five attempts.
documents.title: Webhook retry

documents.body: Each event ID is an idempotency key. Repeated deliveries must not create a second effect.
documents.title: Webhook idempotency

documents.body: Roles are member and owner. Only the owner can change workspace-level access settings.
documents.title: Workspace access

documents.body: Owners can send an invitation from workspace settings. Invitations expire after seven days.
documents.title: Member invitation

documents.body: Moving an organization requires a separately reviewed migration plan and a backup.
documents.title: Organization migration

documents.body: The synthetic backup retention policy keeps daily backups for 30 days.
documents.title: Backup retention

documents.body: The demo session expires after 24 hours. A password reset revokes existing sessions.
documents.title: Session expiration

documents.body: Members can update their own display name and locale from their profile page.
documents.title: Profile update

documents.body: Invoices in this synthetic workspace support USD and EUR. Currency selection happens before purchase.
documents.title: Supported currencies

documents.body: Event history records the actor, timestamp and event ID. Exportable audit records require owner access.
documents.title: Event history

documents.body: An owner can configure a workspace domain after validating DNS ownership.
documents.title: Workspace domain

documents.body: Attachment uploads support PDF and CSV. The maximum file size in the demo is 20 MB.
documents.title: Attachment upload

documents.body: Support for the synthetic Atlas workspace operates Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.
documents.title: Support hours

documents.body: Private owner runbook: incident access keys and recovery steps.
documents.title: Owner access runbook

documents.body: Boreal organization stores data in a different region.
documents.title: Other organization region
